meta.title: corvus-regex-ecma262: the Industry benchmarks
meta.lede: This crate over UTF-8 and UTF-16 beside regex, regress and V8 over the Industry workloads of dotnet/performance.
meta.host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) 6973P-C, Linux 7.0.0-1017-azure, 4 cores (affinity 0-3), load 1.92 at the start
meta.job: each figure the median of 5 passes after a warm-up, 2 s for each workload of each engine, each in a process of its own
facts: Intel(R) Xeon(R) 6973P-C, Linux 7.0.0-1017-azure, 4 cores (affinity 0-3), load 1.92 at the start
each figure the median of 5 passes after a warm-up, 2 s for each workload of each engine, each in a process of its own
meta.method: Each figure is one count of every match a global search finds over the whole text, after an empty match going on one character later. This crate and regress run with the workload's flags and u, regex with the pattern as it is and the flags i, m and s, V8 with gu added.
